correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact wreath-product order recurrence from the published forest decomposition, derived the exponential generating function A(z)=Phi(z)/(2-exp(z)), checked the dominant simple pole at log(2), bounded the forcing series to prove Phi entire, and replayed exact small-n orders plus normalized numerical convergence.

originality.rationale: Targeted searches located the 2020 exact automorphism decomposition and later work on free Gödel algebras, but no source or indexed finding stating an equivalent asymptotic, normalized limit, or the constant Phi(log 2). The claim is restricted to that new asymptotic consequence and does not rebrand the published finite formulas.

value.rationale: The result converts a nested exact finite recursion into a sharp closed asymptotic scale with an explicit computable leading constant, giving quantitative symmetry growth for the free Gödel algebras and an exponentially accurate normalized limit.
